updates.title: See what retention is worth
updates.blurb: The ROI Calculator turns retention into dollars. Plug in your ARR, growth goal, and NRR, and it shows what a strong post-sale motion is actually worth — faster year-one growth, a far lighter new-sales quota, lower cost of churn, and a bigger number at exit. Run it against your own numbers.
